verdict.rationale: Box has a built-in AI layer. Box AI can answer questions, summarize, extract metadata and generate content with permissions intact (box-docs-9, box-docs-26, box-docs-33). It can also populate metadata automatically when a PDF lands in a folder (box-docs-12) and answer questions over curated Box Hubs (box-docs-13), and AI agents are configurable (box-docs-18, box-docs-42). However, almost all of this is documented as an API capability; the in-product assistant is only implied by marketing copy (box-docs-15, box-docs-25), and task delegation is limited to Q&A, summarize and extract rather than open-ended agentic work. Missing for 10: first-party docs of an in-app assistant UI, evidence of multi-step task delegation or action-taking by the assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
